fidelityReview.notes: Compared all39 current frames with four actually inspected public-domain originals, beginning with the three cleared Qualla photographs. The Syced creator-CC0 original adds detailed riverfront and southern broken-wall coverage. Preserved ruined wall/court/drum/dome relationships match the generalized mapped envelope; exposed southern brick and lower surviving plaster were corrected from those originals. The full original roofs, floors and main staircase remain absent. Earlier CC photos, sign reproductions, uncleared drawings and aerial imagery do not supply current approval. Exact damage, plaster islands, hidden openings, small court remains and reinforcement spacing remain conservative medium-fi interpretations; no conservation-survey claim.
